children: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have slightly declined compared to the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max last year, according to data from Bank of America.

"Our tracking of iPhone ship dates on Apple's own website, and various carrier websites, indicates that as of Sep 21st (10 days after preorders started on Fri Sep 12th), ship time (in days) for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models are roughly similar to last year at this point in the preorder cycle," said BofA analyst Wamsi Mohan in an investor note.

"Globally, on average, ship time for the iPhone 18 Pro is currently at 14 days (vs. 15 days for iPhone 17 Pro), while the iPhone 18 Pro Max stands at 20 days (vs. 21 days last year)," he added. "Lead time trends are incrementally positive, with iPhone 18 Pro ship dates stable at 14 days, compared to the iPhone 17 Pro, which saw a slight moderation from 18 days to 15 days."

Shipment times to China stand out as the lowest among all global regions. Ship dates for the iPhone Pro are currently 11 days, and the Pro Max has a lead time of 15 days. Last year, China shipments were in line with most of the international markets. BofA indicated the wait for the iPhone Duo could be contributing to the change versus last year.

Finally, BofA also highlighted the varying price increases across different regions. For example, Japan and India experienced the strongest increases, with prices for the iPhone Pro and Pro Max 256GB increasing by 20% to 23% year over year. Prices in China, the U.K., Germany and the U.S. increased from 8% to 12%, and in Australia prices only climbed by about 5%.
BofA maintained its Buy rating and $370 price target on Apple.

title: Apple's global iPhone 18 ship times decrease slightly year over year: BofA
